item.title: Angel Du$t doesn’t want to sell you something
item.description: Cover Me: Justice Tripp goes into the creative process behind each of his Baltimore hardcore band’s album covers, explaining the design choices, characters and creatures, and the political cover of their new record, COLD 2 THE TOUCH.

item.title: At least straight-to-streaming action film The Bluff is full of ridiculous pirate thrills
item.description: Though it's no buried B-movie treasure, pirate romp The Bluff is rollicking and ridiculous enough to be worth the stream.

item.title: Alysa Liu won Olympic gold and has great music taste
item.description: The world’s coolest girl just got even cooler. After winning two gold medals this Winter Olympics, figure skater and all-around people’s princess Alysa Liu skated to the Zara Larsson remix of PinkPantheress’s “Stateside” at the Olympic Exhibition Gala this past Saturday.

item.title: Inside Jeffrey Epstein’s unrealized “P factor” plan for EMI
item.description: In the DOJ’s email dump, Epstein’s would‑be partners pitch the crumbling record giant as a “troubled industry” but a “great asset to have for P,” revealing how they saw the music business as a pipeline to women.

item.title: One Battle After Another conquers the BAFTAs
item.description: The film picked up six wins, including one for Sean Penn's performance.
